argv: set -e; test "$(systemctl is-active llama-swap.service)" = inactive; test -z "$(nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid --format=csv,noheader)"; nvidia-smi; journalctl -k -b --no-pager --grep="pci .*gpu_unlock: unlocked"
